rv.q: For fans of “Fun Home,” the 2015. Broadway musical by Lisa Kron and Jeanine Tesori that won five Tony Awards, a trip to downtown Aurora in coming weeks is essential.
Under the direction of Jim Corti and Landree Fleming, this cast presents an unforgettable evening of theater.
This is simply the best Fun Home I have ever seen, and it goes away all too soon, so make the trip; you'll thank me.
Musically and narratively, this show soars.
I can unequivocally say that the show was absolutely worth the trip.
Ultimately it is this sense of optimism that lifts the entire production.

cn.t: Paramount's production of the Tony-winning musical earns rave reviews for its brilliant, emotionally resonant staging that finds new nuances in Alison Bechdel's memoir about family, sexuality, and her closeted father.
